name: Agent Keypad for Orca
description: See at a glance which Orca agent needs you. Each agent chat or pane gets a key on the Logi MX Creative Keypad that shows its state and opens it when pressed.

cover.alt: A Stream Deck showing Orca agent panes as colored keys: working, done, idle and empty

screenshots.alt: A 5x3 Stream Deck grid of Orca pane keys with status icons
screenshots.caption: Know which agent is working, done or waiting for you, without switching windows

screenshots.alt: A Stream Deck in front of a laptop, its keys lit with agent status colors and one key counting 1 agent that needs you
screenshots.caption: Your agents, one glance away

statusBarItems.tooltip: Open Agent Keypad: the panel to map Orca panes and agent chats to keypad keys
